invariant: A reuse action consumes and retains the bytes whose digest was verified. Changed calibration or artifact invalidates observation; confirmation always executes; unknown is unresolved.

observation: Existing calibration.observe and calibration_policy.observe; authored scalar data, center 10/11, diagnostic 15; fresh confirmation positions 26 and 27.
scorer: Existing calibration.evaluate/review; independent expected identity from native JSON bytes and analytic normalization (position-center)/10; center 10 adopt, center 11 reject.

calibration center 10 to 11 plus new admission digest: rerun and reject

comparison: Three exposed revision cells for base SDK, candidate SDK and existing dependency-aware native_calibration/native_selector. acceptance: before test must reproduce byte mismatch, not setup failure
all 11 regressions pass after with unchanged test hash
